text.en:
Casting Thruster grants x6 <arc/>Bolt Charge. Casting your Barricade grants x4 <arc/>Bolt Charge to you and nearby allies.

While within your Barricade's area of effect, you and allies gain x1 stack of <arc/>Bolt Charge every 0.6 seconds, and can discharge <arc/>Bolt Charge through weapon damage.

<arc/>Spark of Frequency does not increase the rate at which the barricade grants <arc/>Bolt Charge. 

Multiple <arc/>Storm's Keep Barricades do not stack.
